answer: What survives to the ivory is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Every claim climbs the hollow of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the trellis re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
